verdict.rationale: The docs show a direct Hugging Face download-and-run command: `local-ai run huggingface://TheBloke/phi-2-GGUF/phi-2.Q8_0.gguf`. This is backed by gallery installs, URI-based runs (including ollama://) and preloading models via the /models/apply parameters, so the core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Hugging Face integration (supported formats beyond GGUF, gated or private repo authentication, Hugging Face browsing or search), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
